title: Inclusive Accessibility for People with Disabilities as Key Goal of Program
summary: The newspaper reports that a specific program lists 'comprehensive accessibility for people with disabilities' as its primary objective, indicating a focus on ensuring physical and/or digital access accommodations.
body:
The newspaper reports that a specific program lists 'comprehensive accessibility for people with disabilities' as its primary objective, indicating a focus on ensuring physical and/or digital access accommodations.
